promise: He will lower the cost of living and make life easier for New Yorkers.
quote: Zohran will lower costs and make life easier.

promise: He will freeze rent prices in the city.
quote: Freeze the rent.

promise: He will construct more affordable housing.
quote: Building affordable housing.

promise: He will take strict action against bad landlords.
quote: Cracking down on bad landlords.

promise: He will support homeowners and put an end to deed theft.
quote: Supporting homeowners and ending deed theft.

promise: He will establish a Department of Community Safety.
quote: The Department of Community Safety

promise: He will establish city-owned grocery stores to provide affordable food options.
quote: City-owned grocery stores.

promise: He will implement fast and fare-free bus transit.
quote: Fast, fare free buses.

promise: He will combat corporate exploitation.
quote: Fighting corporate exploitation.

promise: He will provide childcare services at no cost to families.
quote: No cost childcare.

promise: He will distribute baby baskets to newborns in New York.
quote: Baby baskets for New York’s newborns.

promise: He will increase taxes on corporations and the wealthiest one percent of residents.
quote: Taxing Corporations & the 1%

promise: He will implement environmental upgrades under the Green Schools initiative.
quote: Green Schools For A Healthier NY
target: Green Schools For A Healthier NY

promise: He will guarantee legal protections for LGBTQIA+ individuals.
quote: LGBTQIA+ Protections

promise: He will raise the minimum wage to $30 by the year 2030.
quote: Raising the minimum wage to $30 by 2030.

promise: He will regulate delivery applications and protect delivery workers.
quote: Regulating delivery apps & protecting delivery workers.

promise: He will implement policies to protect New York City against decisions of the Trump administration.
quote: Trump-Proofing NYC

promise: Triple the city's production of publicly subsidized, permanently affordable, union-built, rent-stabilized homes, constructing 200,000 new units over the next 10 years.
quote: Zohran will triple the City’s production of publicly subsidized, permanently affordable, union-built, rent-stabilized homes, constructing 200,000 new units over the next 10 years.

promise: Fast-track 100% affordable developments, reducing approval times for projects like those at West 108th Street, the Inwood library, and the Greenpoint Hospital site.
quote: Any 100% affordable development gets fast-tracked: projects like the 200 deeply affordable units at West 108th Street, the 175 affordable units above the new Inwood library, and the 500 affordable units on the site of the long-vacant Greenpoint Hospital will no longer take years to get approved.
location: West 108th Street, Inwood library, Greenpoint Hospital

promise: Double capital spending to preserve public housing and fully fund and staff city housing agencies.
quote: We’ll also double the money we’re spending to preserve public housing, and fully fund and staff our city’s housing agencies so we can actually get the work done.

promise: Invest $100 billion over 10 years to provide housing for families earning under $70,000 a year.
quote: This $100 billion dollar commitment over 10 years will once again make New York City a leader in providing homes for families who earn less than $70,000 a year—the median income for renters in New York—and ensure that our City’s resources are used to provide jobs with safety and dignity.

promise: Triple the amount of housing constructed using City capital funds.
quote: Triple the amount of housing built with City capital funds.

promise: Construct 200,000 new affordable homes over 10 years for low-income households, seniors, and working families.
quote: A Mamdani administration will construct 200,000 new affordable homes over 10 years for low-income households, seniors, and working families.

promise: Significantly expand the Senior Affordable Rental Apartments (SARA) program to produce more low-income housing for seniors.
quote: We’ll significantly expand programs that serve families with the greatest need: HPD’s Senior Affordable Rental Apartments (SARA), which produces 100% affordable low-income housing for seniors.

promise: Significantly expand the Extremely Low and Low-Income Affordability (ELLA) program to build housing for families earning under $72,000.
quote: HPD’s Extremely Low and Low-Income Affordability (ELLA), which produces 100% affordable housing for families who earn less than $72,000 for a family of four

promise: Expand HRA's Master Lease Program to pool rental assistance programs to create subsidized housing.
quote: HRA’s Master Lease Program, which allows the City to pool its rental assistance programs (like CityFHEPS) to create project-based, subsidized housing for families at risk of eviction and/or living in the shelter program.

promise: Drop lawsuits against CityFHEPS expansion and ensure the program's expansion proceeds as scheduled under City Law.
quote: This will go even further, as Zohran will drop lawsuits against CityFHEPs and ensure expansion proceeds as scheduled and per City Law.

promise: Double capital investments in NYCHA renovations, develop housing on NYCHA parking lots, and use City subsidies directly for upgrades.
quote: Zohran will double the City’s capital investment in major renovations of NYCHA housing, activate underutilized storage areas like parking lots for affordable housing development, and use tools like City subsidies to invest money directly in upgrading our public housing.

promise: Use City capital to build new affordable, publicly-controlled housing on NYCHA land.
quote: Some of the City capital for new construction will be used to build new affordable, publicly-controlled housing on NYCHA’s City-owned land.

promise: Lobby the state government in Albany to establish an annual capital commitment to NYCHA.
quote: Zohran will also push Albany to make a similar commitment to NYCHA’s capital needs on an annual basis.

promise: Fully fund and staff the operating budgets of housing agencies including HPD, DCP, and NYCHA.
quote: Zohran will fully fund and staff the operating budgets of the City’s housing agencies—including Housing Preservation & Development (HPD), the Department of City Planning (DCP), and the New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA)—which have been woefully neglected under Mayor Adams.

promise: Increase staffing levels for financial closing and project management in construction and renovation pipelines.
quote: Zohran will increase staffing levels for financial closing and project management in construction and renovation pipelines to move projects forward more quickly.

promise: Expedite land use reviews for development projects that meet affordability, stabilization, union labor, and sustainability goals.
quote: Any project that commits to the administration’s affordability, stabilization, union labor, and sustainability goals will be expedited through land use review.

promise: Direct the Office of Management and Budget to avoid bottlenecking development pipelines and city services.
quote: Zohran will break that bottleneck by directing OMB to ensure that our resources are managed responsibly without hamstringing city services, including the development pipeline for affordable housing.

promise: Lobby state and federal governments to raise the city's public debt ceiling and remove volume caps on affordable housing bonds.
quote: advocate in Albany to increase the City’s public debt ceiling and in Washington to remove the City’s volume cap for affordable housing bond financing

promise: Allocate $70 billion in new capital via municipal bonds in the Ten-Year Capital Plan for affordable housing.
quote: Zohran will allocate $70 billion new capital dollars in the City’s Ten-Year Capital Plan to create new affordable housing, raised on the municipal bond market.

promise: Pursue a Comprehensive City Plan to direct growth, housing development, and equity.
quote: Zohran will give the public a firmer hand in guiding housing development across New York by pursuing a Comprehensive City plan.

promise: Increase zoned capacity to allow mixed-income and affordable housing in neighborhoods historically left out of zoning goals, including areas excluded from City of Yes.
quote: Increasing zoned capacity. This will allow housing supply to meet New York’s demand for both mixed-income and permanently affordable housing in areas that have historically not contributed to citywide housing goals—including those cut out of City of Yes.

promise: Encourage housing growth around subway stations and public transit hubs to support climate sustainability.
quote: By encouraging growth around subway stations and other public transit hubs across New York City, we will create a greener city.

promise: Eliminate parking minimums to prioritize housing construction over parking lots.
quote: Eliminating parking minimums. The City should be building housing, not parking lots.

promise: Lobby in Albany to expand rent stabilization rules to cover all new housing production.
quote: Zohran will advocate in Albany to expand rent stabilization to all new production as it was under 421a—ensuring that any new housing built in our city provides a stable home for those who live there.

promise: Rebuild the Mayor’s Office to Protect Tenants to safeguard New York City renters.
quote: Zohran will rebuild the Mayor’s Office to Protect Tenants —a longstanding tool of City Hall that has been defunded and deprioritized under Mayor Adams.

promise: Coordinate housing code enforcement across city agencies under the Mayor's Office to Protect Tenants.
quote: Under Zohran’s administration, the Mayor’s Office to Protect Tenants will coordinate code enforcement under one roof—from the inspectors who come to our apartments to the lawyers who litigate in Housing Court—enabling the City’s ability to resolve issues quickly.

promise: Allow tenants to schedule inspection appointments and receive text reminders.
quote: We will enable tenants to schedule an appointment with an inspector and receive reminders over text.

promise: Create a centralized, user-friendly website portal for tracking housing violations and fines.
quote: We will also create one website —a centralized and user-friendly portal—where tenants and inspectors can track all violations and fines owed in a building.

promise: Double the fines for hazardous housing violations and triple them for immediately hazardous violations.
quote: We will double the fines for hazardous violations (cracks in the walls, broken windows, water damage, roaches, and defective locks) and triple fines for immediately hazardous violations (vermin, heat and hot water, lead paint).
target: double the fines for hazardous violations and triple fines for immediately hazardous violations

promise: Ensure outstanding and future housing violation fines are actually collected.
quote: Most importantly, we will ensure fines are actually collected, which will bring at least $800M immediately owed back to the city and generate hundreds of millions more each year.

promise: Update the Housing Maintenance Code by 2025 to make failing to provide adequate cooling during summer a Class C violation.
quote: We will update the Housing Maintenance Code to meet the needs of the city in 2025 and make it a Class C violation to fail to provide adequately cool apartments during the summer months.

promise: Require building owners to maintain indoor temperatures at or below 78°F when it is 82°F or hotter outdoors.
quote: We will require building owners to maintain a maximum indoor temperature of 78°F when the outdoor temperature is 82°F or higher.

promise: Install heat sensors in buildings with recurrent heat violations.
quote: We will also install heat sensors in buildings with repeated heat violations.

promise: Hire more public staff, including inspectors and lawyers, to enforce housing and environmental codes.
quote: Zohran’s administration will hire more public servants to do the critical work of enforcing the housing maintenance code, building code, fire code, and environmental standards, health standards, and more.

promise: Double the capacity of the Alternative Enforcement Program and expand the Office of Special Enforcement.
quote: Zohran will double the size of the Alternative Enforcement Program and expand the Office of Special Enforcement, so repeat offenders are finally held accountable through higher fines.

promise: Restore funding for the Anti-Harassment Tenant Protection program.
quote: He will also restore funding to the Anti-Harassment Tenant Protection program which supports at-risk tenants in bringing affirmative cases against their negligent landlords without risk of abuse.

promise: Use the City's legal power to perform repairs and bill negligent landlords directly.
quote: Zohran will use the law when necessary, so no tenant lives in unsafe, poor-quality housing.

promise: Bar uncooperative, repeat-offending landlords from operating in New York City.
quote: Under Zohran’s administration, landlords who do not work with the Office to Protect Tenants and repeatedly put New Yorkers at risk will not be allowed to operate in New York City — with no exceptions.

promise: Fully fund the Neighborhood Pillars program at the level secured by the City Council.
quote: We will fully fund Neighborhood Pillars at the level secured by City Council and unlock the City’s full power to improve our neighborhoods and the health of our communities.
target: at least 20,000 homes over the next 10 years
